# invoice-kit

**Patient bills for the lab: exact to the paisa, printed on the same letterhead as the reports.**

Tests · packages · services · consumables · medicines · GST · discounts · split payments · amount in words

[![Backend](https://img.shields.io/badge/side-backend-14264A)](#)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-14264A?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](#)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-14264A?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](#)

## What you get

- **Every kind of line item:** lab tests, health packages, services (home collection, urgent report),
  consumables and medicines, each with qty, rate, % or flat discount, optional GST % / HSN / batch note.
- **Bill-level discount** (% or flat, with a reason), shared across lines *before* tax.
- **GST per rate.** Discount and GST columns appear only when used; lab tests are usually exempt.
- **Round-off, grand total and amount in words** in the Indian system (lakh / crore).
- **Payments:** split Cash/UPI/Card/…, paid, balance due or refund, and a **PAID · PARTIALLY PAID · DUE** stamp.
- **Codes:** Code 128 barcode of the invoice number, plus a **UPI scan-to-pay QR** when the lab sets its UPI ID.
- **Same letterhead as the reports**, header and non-header (pre-printed paper), multi-page with *Page X of Y*.
- **One API for everything:** `createMgplApi()` serves invoice *and* report routes.

## Quick start

```bash
npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit react react-dom
```

```ts
import { buildInvoice, computeInvoice, renderInvoicePdf } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";

const invoice = buildInvoice({
  invoiceNo: "MGPL/2026-27/0399",
  patient: { title: "Mr", name: "Ramesh Kumar Verma", age: 67, sex: "Male", patientId: "MGPL1024" },
  items: [
    "full-body-checkup",                                  // price-list code
    "home-collection",
    { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 },                      // code + overrides
    { name: "Special stain", category: "test", rate: 450 }, // free-form line
  ],
  discount: { percent: 10, reason: "Senior citizen" },
  payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 2000, reference: "UTR 428615903317" }],
});

computeInvoice(invoice);   // { total, due, status: "PARTIALLY PAID", taxByRate, … }
const pdf = await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant: "header" });
```

## One backend for reports and invoices

```ts
// Next.js — app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
import { createMgplApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
const api = createMgplApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" });
export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };
export const runtime = "nodejs";
```

```ts
// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
```

```ts
// Express / node:http
import { toNodeHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createMgplApi()));
```

Frontends call it with [`@mgpl-diagnostics/client`](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client):
`client.invoices.totals(invoice)`, `client.invoices.pdf({ invoice })`, …

## HTTP API

| Method & route | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /invoice` | `{ invoice, variant, format: "pdf" \| "html" \| "json" }` | PDF, HTML, or the full calculation as JSON |
| `GET /price-list` | | `[{ code, name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }]` |
| `GET /invoice-samples` | | demo invoices (only with `samples: true`) |
| *all report-kit routes* | | `/templates`, `/report`, `/letterhead`, `/assets/*`, `/health` |

Invalid input (missing patient, unknown price code, negative rate…) returns `400 { "error": "…" }`.

## How the maths works

All arithmetic is in **integer paise**, so totals never drift by a paisa.

1. line gross = qty × rate
2. line discount (percent wins over a flat amount)
3. bill discount, shared across lines in proportion (largest-remainder, so the shares add up exactly)
4. GST on what remains, grouped by rate
5. round-off to the nearest rupee (unless `roundOff: false`)

The **Amount** column shows `qty × rate − line discount`; bill discount, GST and round-off appear in the totals.
The smoke test checks these against hand-computed values on every run.

## Price list

[`src/price-list.ts`](src/price-list.ts) maps codes → `{ name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }`. Test codes are the
report-kit template ids, so `itemsForTests(["cbc", "kft"])` bills a report's tests.

> **The rates shipped here are sample placeholders.** Pass your real list with `buildInvoice({ …, priceList })`,
> or edit the file, and have your accountant confirm GST rates and HSN codes.

Lab settings in report-kit's lab profile: `upiId` (scan-to-pay QR), `gstin` and `registrationNo` (under the title),
`invoiceTerms` (printed under the payments).

## Development

```bash
npm install
npm run typecheck
npm run smoke      # arithmetic checks + every sample as HTML & PDF, values verified inside the PDFs
npm run test:api   # the HTTP API, the client SDK, Fastify and node:http end to end
npm run examples   # examples/index.html
```

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the money and rendering rules, [docs/api.md](docs/api.md) for the full API,
and [llms.txt](llms.txt) / [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt) for AI tools.

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit

Instructions for AI coding agents and developers. Read
[report-kit's AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit/blob/main/AGENTS.md) too:
the same rendering rules apply.

## What this is

The **backend** library (Node.js ≥ 20) for patient invoices. Each invoice is rendered twice, identically:
- **HTML:** `src/InvoiceDocument.tsx`, a pure React component;
- **PDF:** `src/InvoicePdf.tsx`, react-pdf.

It also owns **`createMgplApi()`**, the single HTTP handler for reports *and* invoices (report-kit's
routes plus `/invoice`, `/price-list`, `/invoice-samples`), and the Fastify plugin that wraps it.

The letterhead layer, fonts, assets, barcode, QR, HTTP helpers and `defaultLab()` (real signatures from
env files) come from `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit`, which is a peer dependency. There is no browser code
here; frontends use `@mgpl-diagnostics/client`.

## Map

```
src/
  index.ts        package entry (everything except the Fastify plugin)
  fastify.ts      "/fastify" entry: mgplFastify → createMgplApi
  api.ts          createMgplApi, createInvoiceRoutes, invoiceFromRequest (validation), invoiceTotalsJson
  types.ts        Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment, ItemCategory, PaymentStatus
  calc.ts         computeInvoice (integer paise), money(), amountInWords() (Indian lakh/crore)
  price-list.ts   PRICE_LIST — SAMPLE prices; codes = report-kit template/profile ids + services/consumables/medicines
  build.ts        buildInvoice (codes → lines, overrides), itemsForTests
  layout.ts       geometry (inches/pt), shared by both renderers
  model.ts        display logic: grouped rows, dynamic columns, totals lines, cards, QR, pagination
  styles.ts       CSS (report-kit sidebarCss + invoice parts)
  InvoiceDocument.tsx / InvoicePdf.tsx
  pdf.ts          renderInvoicePdf
  server.ts       renderInvoiceHtml
  samples.ts      INVOICE_SAMPLES (fictional)
scripts/          smoke-test.tsx, api-test.ts (HTTP + client + Fastify + node:http), generate-examples.tsx
dist/             build output — git-ignored; built by `prepare` and in CI
```

## Money rules

- All arithmetic in `calc.ts` uses **integer paise**. Do not add float maths elsewhere. Format with `money()`.
- Order of operations:
  1. line gross = qty × rate;
  2. line discount (percent wins over amount);
  3. bill discount, shared in proportion with the largest-remainder rule so the shares add up exactly;
  4. GST on what remains;
  5. round-off to the rupee (unless `roundOff: false`).
- The Amount column shows `qty × rate − line discount`. Bill discount, GST and round-off appear only in the totals.
- Status: `PAID` if paid ≥ total, `PARTIALLY PAID` if 0 < paid < total, otherwise `DUE`; `excess` = refund.
- Currency is written `Rs.`, because the Manrope font has no `₹` glyph.

## Rendering rules (react-pdf)

- Every fixed-height row needs `lineHeight: 1` on its texts. Text taller than its box is **silently
  dropped**. The info cards once lost all their values this way; the smoke test now checks that every
  value is present in the PDF text.
- Card rows must fit: `5 × INV_CARDS.lineH + 2 × pad ≤ INV_CARDS.h` (checked by smoke).
- Column widths come from `invoiceColumns()`. Discount and GST columns appear only when used; the
  description column takes the remaining width.
- Pagination (`invoicePages`) keeps group headings with their first item and keeps the totals
  block whole on the last page.

## Commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run smoke   # required before committing
npm run test:api                     # required when api.ts or the HTTP contract changes
npm run build                        # dist/ (git-ignored)
npm run examples                     # inspect PDFs visually
```

## Contract with the client

`InvoiceRequest` / `invoiceTotalsJson()` are mirrored in `@mgpl-diagnostics/client` (`InvoiceInput`,
`InvoiceTotals`). report-studio's `contract-check.ts` fails its typecheck if they drift; change both repos together.

## Privacy and licence

Never commit real patient or billing data, or real signatures. Samples use fictional names.
The code is "All rights reserved" (see LICENSE).

## File: docs/api.md

# API reference: @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit (v2)

Backend only (Node.js ≥ 20); peer dependency `@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit` ^2.
Entry points: `@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit` and `@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify`.

## HTTP API: reports and invoices in one handler

```ts
createMgplApi(opts?: ApiOptions): (req: Request) => Promise<Response>   // ApiOptions from report-kit
createInvoiceRoutes(opts?): (req: Request) => Promise<Response | null>  // invoice routes only (null = not mine)

// Fastify
import { mgplFastify } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify";
await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" });
```

| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `POST /invoice` | body `InvoiceRequest` → PDF (default), HTML (`format: "html"`) or the calculation (`format: "json"`) |
| `GET /price-list` | `[{ code, name, category, rate, taxPercent?, hsn? }]` |
| `GET /invoice-samples` | `[{ id, label, invoiceNo }]` (only with `samples: true`) |
| all report-kit routes | `/health`, `/templates`, `/samples`, `/report`, `/letterhead`, `/assets/*` |

```ts
interface InvoiceRequest {
  invoice?: BuildInvoiceInput;   // items may be codes, code + overrides, or full items
  sample?: string;
  variant?: "header" | "non-header";
  format?: "pdf" | "html" | "json";
  fileName?: string; download?: boolean;
}
```

Validation (400): `invoiceNo`, `patient.name/age/sex`, non-empty `items` (≤ 500), known price codes,
`rate ≥ 0`, `qty > 0`, `taxPercent` 0–100, `payments[].amount ≥ 0`.
`invoiceFromRequest(body, opts)` and `invoiceTotalsJson(invoice)` are exported for custom routes.

## Billing

```ts
buildInvoice(input: BuildInvoiceInput): Invoice
interface BuildInvoiceInput {
  invoiceNo: string; date?: Date | string; patient: Patient;
  items: ItemInput[];   // "cbc" | { code: "cbc", qty?, rate?, discountPercent?, … } | InvoiceItem
  discount?: { percent?: number; amount?: number; reason?: string };
  payments?: Payment[]; notes?: string[]; roundOff?: boolean; title?: string;
  priceList?: Record<string, PriceEntry>;
}
itemsForTests(ids: string[]): ItemInput[]

interface InvoiceItem {
  code?: string; name: string; category: "test" | "profile" | "medicine" | "consumable" | "service" | "other";
  qty?: number; rate: number; discountPercent?: number; discountAmount?: number;
  taxPercent?: number; hsn?: string; note?: string;
}
interface Payment { mode: string; amount: number; date?: Date | string; reference?: string }

computeInvoice(inv): InvoiceTotals
// { lines, subtotal, lineDiscount, billDiscount, taxable, tax, taxByRate, roundOff, total,
//   paid, due, excess, status: "PAID" | "PARTIALLY PAID" | "DUE", hasTax, hasDiscount }
money(n)            // "1,23,456.50"
amountInWords(n)    // "Rupees One Lakh … Only"
CURRENCY            // "Rs."
PRICE_LIST, INVOICE_SAMPLES, CATEGORY_LABEL, INVOICE_LAYOUT
```

## Rendering

```ts
renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant, lab?, publicDir? }): Promise<Buffer>
renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice, variant, lab?, inline? = true, fontBase? }): Promise<string>
<InvoiceDocument invoice variant lab? includeStyles? fontBase? />    // React, rendered on the server
InvoicePdf                                                           // react-pdf <Document>
invoicePages(inv, lab), invoiceQr(inv, totals, lab)                  // shared page split / QR value
```

## File: llms.txt

# @mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit

> Backend-only TypeScript library (Node.js >= 20) for MGPL Diagnostics patient invoices. It handles tests, packages, services, consumables and medicines with qty/rate/discount/GST/HSN, a bill discount shared before tax, round-off, split payments, PAID/PARTIALLY PAID/DUE status and amount in words (Indian). Arithmetic is done in integer paise. Invoices render as PDF (react-pdf) or HTML on the report-kit letterhead. It also provides `createMgplApi()`, one HTTP handler for reports AND invoices, with a Fastify plugin. Peer dependency: @mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit.

Key facts for agents:
- Mount: `createMgplApi({ basePath: "/api/mgpl" })`; Fastify `mgplFastify` from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify"; Express via report-kit's `toNodeHandler`.
- Routes: POST /invoice (format pdf|html|json), GET /price-list, GET /invoice-samples (opt-in), plus every report-kit route.
- In code: `buildInvoice({ invoiceNo, patient, items: ["cbc", { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }], discount, payments })`, then `computeInvoice()` / `renderInvoicePdf()`.
- PRICE_LIST rates are SAMPLE placeholders. Currency is written "Rs." (the font has no rupee glyph). Amount column = qty × rate − line discount.
- Run `npm run smoke` (maths, fit, glyphs, PDF text) and `npm run test:api` (HTTP + client + Fastify + node:http) after changes.

## File: scripts/api-test.ts

```ts
// End-to-end test of the client/backend split:
//   1. createMgplApi() called directly with Fetch Requests (every route + error cases)
//   2. @mgpl-diagnostics/client SDK against that handler
//   3. the Fastify plugin (app.inject), incl. that the app's own JSON routes still work
//   4. a real node:http server via toNodeHandler + the client over the network
//   npm run test:api
import { createServer } from "node:http";
import type { AddressInfo } from "node:net";
import Fastify from "fastify";
import { createMgplClient, MgplApiError } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import { toNodeHandler } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { createMgplApi } from "../src";
import { mgplFastify } from "../src/fastify";

const problems: string[] = [];
let passed = 0;
const check = (name: string, ok: unknown, detail = "") => {
  if (ok) passed++;
  else problems.push(`${name}${detail ? `: ${detail}` : ""}`);
};
const BASE = "/api/mgpl";
const ORIGIN = "http://lab.test";
const api = createMgplApi({ basePath: BASE, samples: true, cors: "*" });
const call = (path: string, init?: RequestInit) => api(new Request(ORIGIN + BASE + path, init));
const post = (path: string, body: unknown) => call(path, { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });
const isPdf = async (r: Response) => new TextDecoder().decode((await r.clone().arrayBuffer()).slice(0, 5)) === "%PDF-";

const patient = { title: "Mr", name: "Api Test", age: 40, sex: "Male", patientId: "MGPL9001" };
const invoice = {
  invoiceNo: "API/0001",
  patient,
  items: ["cbc", { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }, { name: "Custom", category: "other", rate: 99.5 }],
  discount: { percent: 10 },
  payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 100, reference: "UTR1" }],
};

async function direct() {
  // reads
  let r = await call("/health");
  check("GET /health", r.status === 200 && (await r.json()).ok === true);
  r = await call("/templates");
  const cat = await r.json();
  check("GET /templates", r.status === 200 && cat.templates.length >= 31 && cat.profiles.length >= 7 && cat.templates.find((t: { id: string }) => t.id === "cbc")?.fields.length > 10);
  r = await call("/samples");
  check("GET /samples", r.status === 200 && (await r.json()).length >= 39);
  r = await call("/price-list");
  check("GET /price-list", r.status === 200 && (await r.json()).some((p: { code: string }) => p.code === "home-collection"));
  r = await call("/invoice-samples");
  check("GET /invoice-samples", r.status === 200 && (await r.json()).length >= 5);

  // reports
  r = await post("/report", { patient, tests: [{ template: "kft", results: { urea: "52", creatinine: "1.6" } }], format: "pdf" });
  check("POST /report pdf", r.status === 200 && r.headers.get("content-type") === "application/pdf" && (await isPdf(r)));
  r = await post("/report", { patient, profile: { id: "liver-kidney-profile", results: { lft: { bilTotal: "0.8" } } }, design: "classic", variant: "non-header", format: "pdf" });
  check("POST /report profile classic", r.status === 200 && (await isPdf(r)));
  r = await post("/report", { sample: "cbc", format: "html" });
  const html = await r.text();
  check("POST /report html", r.status === 200 && html.includes("<!doctype html>") && html.includes("Haemoglobin"));
  // every asset the HTML references must be served by the backend
  const assetUrls = [...new Set([...html.matchAll(/(?:src="|url\(")([^"]+\/assets\/[^"]+)"/g)].map((m) => m[1]))];
  check("HTML references backend assets", assetUrls.length >= 5, `${assetUrls.length} urls`);
  for (const u of assetUrls) {
    const a = await api(new Request(u));
    check(`asset ${u.split("/assets/")[1]}`, a.status === 200 && (a.headers.get("cache-control") ?? "").includes("immutable"));
  }
  r = await post("/report", { patient, tests: [{ template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10" } }], format: "pdf", download: true, fileName: "x y.pdf" });
  check("download disposition", (r.headers.get("content-disposition") ?? "").startsWith('attachment; filename="x_y.pdf"'));

  // letterhead
  r = await call("/letterhead?format=pdf");
  check("GET /letterhead pdf", r.status === 200 && (await isPdf(r)));
  r = await call("/letterhead?format=html");
  check("GET /letterhead html", r.status === 200 && (await r.text()).includes("sb-side"));

  // invoices
  r = await post("/invoice", { invoice, format: "json" });
  const t = await r.json();
  // 300 + 2×10×1.12 GST + 99.50 → 10% bill discount before tax → check the server maths shape
  check("POST /invoice json", r.status === 200 && t.status === "PARTIALLY PAID" && t.paid === 100 && t.lines.length === 3 && t.amountInWords.startsWith("Rupees"));
  check("invoice discount shares add up", Math.round(t.lines.reduce((a: number, l: { billDiscount: number }) => a + l.billDiscount, 0) * 100) === Math.round(t.billDiscount * 100));
  r = await post("/invoice", { invoice, format: "pdf" });
  check("POST /invoice pdf", r.status === 200 && (await isPdf(r)));
  r = await post("/invoice", { sample: "due-gst", format: "html", variant: "non-header" });
  const ih = await r.text();
  check("POST /invoice html", r.status === 200 && ih.includes("INVOICE") && !ih.includes('class="sb-side"'));

  // errors
  const expectStatus = async (name: string, res: Promise<Response>, status: number) => {
    const x = await res;
    const body = await x.json().catch(() => ({}));
    check(name, x.status === status && typeof body.error === "string", `got ${x.status}`);
  };
  await expectStatus("bad JSON → 400", call("/report", { method: "POST", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: "{oops" }), 400);
  await expectStatus("missing patient → 400", post("/report", { tests: [] }), 400);
  await expectStatus("unknown template → 400", post("/report", { patient, tests: [{ template: "nope", results: {} }] }), 400);
  await expectStatus("unknown price code → 400", post("/invoice", { invoice: { ...invoice, items: ["no-such-code"] } }), 400);
  await expectStatus("negative rate → 400", post("/invoice", { invoice: { ...invoice, items: [{ name: "x", category: "other", rate: -5 }] } }), 400);
  await expectStatus("GET /report → 405", call("/report"), 405);
  await expectStatus("unknown route → 404", call("/nope"), 404);
  await expectStatus("path traversal → 404", call("/assets/report-fonts/..%2F..%2Fpackage.json"), 404);
  await expectStatus("body too large → 413", post("/report", { patient, pad: "x".repeat(1_100_000) }), 413);
  const noSamples = createMgplApi({ basePath: BASE });
  r = await noSamples(new Request(ORIGIN + BASE + "/report", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ sample: "cbc" }) }));
  check("samples disabled by default → 400", r.status === 400);

  // CORS
  r = await call("/report", { method: "OPTIONS" });
  check("OPTIONS preflight", r.status === 204 && r.headers.get("access-control-allow-origin") === "*" && (r.headers.get("access-control-allow-methods") ?? "").includes("POST"));
  r = await call("/templates");
  check("CORS on responses", r.headers.get("access-control-allow-origin") === "*");
  console.log(`direct handler: ${passed} checks`);
}

async function viaClient(label: string, client: ReturnType<typeof createMgplClient>) {
  const before = passed;
  const cat = await client.reports.templates();
  check(`${label}: templates`, cat.templates.length >= 31);
  const pdf = await client.reports.pdf({ patient, tests: [{ template: "cbc", results: { hb: "10.8" } }] });
  check(`${label}: report pdf`, pdf.type === "application/pdf" && pdf.size > 10_000);
  const html = await client.reports.html({ sample: "lipid", variant: "non-header" });
  check(`${label}: report html`, html.includes("Lipid"));
  const totals = await client.invoices.totals(invoice as never);
  check(`${label}: invoice totals`, totals.total > 0 && totals.status === "PARTIALLY PAID");
  const ipdf = await client.invoices.pdf({ invoice: invoice as never });
  check(`${label}: invoice pdf`, ipdf.size > 10_000);
  const prices = await client.invoices.priceList();
  check(`${label}: price list`, prices.length > 30);
  try {
    await client.reports.pdf({ tests: [] });
    check(`${label}: error surfaces`, false, "no error thrown");
  } catch (e) {
    check(`${label}: error surfaces as MgplApiError`, e instanceof MgplApiError && e.status === 400 && /patient/.test(e.message));
  }
  console.log(`${label}: ${passed - before} checks`);
}

async function fastify() {
  const before = passed;
  const app = Fastify();
  // the app's own JSON route must keep normal JSON parsing (plugin is encapsulated)
  app.post("/echo", async (req) => ({ got: (req.body as { a: number }).a }));
  await app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: BASE, samples: true });
  await app.ready();
  let r = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: `${BASE}/templates` });
  check("fastify GET /templates", r.statusCode === 200 && JSON.parse(r.body).templates.length >= 31);
  r = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: `${BASE}/report`, payload: { patient, tests: [{ template: "cbc", results: { hb: "9" } }] } });
  check("fastify POST /report pdf", r.statusCode === 200 && r.headers["content-type"] === "application/pdf" && r.rawPayload.subarray(0, 5).toString() === "%PDF-");
  r = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: `${BASE}/invoice`, payload: { invoice, format: "json" } });
  check("fastify POST /invoice json", r.statusCode === 200 && JSON.parse(r.body).lines.length === 3);
  r = await app.inject({ method: "GET", url: `${BASE}/assets/report-fonts/manrope-400.woff` });
  check("fastify asset", r.statusCode === 200 && r.headers["content-type"] === "font/woff");
  r = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: `${BASE}/report`, payload: { tests: [] } });
  check("fastify 400", r.statusCode === 400);
  r = await app.inject({ method: "POST", url: "/echo", payload: { a: 7 } });
  check("fastify app routes unaffected", r.statusCode === 200 && JSON.parse(r.body).got === 7);
  await app.close();
  console.log(`fastify plugin: ${passed - before} checks`);
}

async function nodeHttp() {
  const server = createServer(toNodeHandler(api));
  await new Promise<void>((res) => server.listen(0, "127.0.0.1", res));
  const { port } = server.address() as AddressInfo;
  try {
    await viaClient("node:http + client over network", createMgplClient({ baseUrl: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}${BASE}` }));
  } finally {
    server.close();
  }
}

async function main() {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  await direct();
  await viaClient("client → handler", createMgplClient({ baseUrl: ORIGIN + BASE, fetch: (input, init) => api(new Request(input, init)) }));
  await fastify();
  await nodeHttp();
  console.log(`\n${passed} checks passed in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s`);
  if (problems.length) {
    console.log(`\n${problems.length} problem(s):`);
    for (const p of problems) console.log("  - " + p);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log("All API checks passed.");
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});

## File: scripts/generate-examples.tsx

```tsx
// Writes examples/: self-contained HTML + A4 PDF for every sample invoice (header / non-header).
//   npm run examples
import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import type { ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { INVOICE_SAMPLES } from "../src";
import { renderInvoicePdf } from "../src";
import { renderInvoiceHtml } from "../src";

async function main() {
  const out = join(process.cwd(), "examples");
  rmSync(out, { recursive: true, force: true });
  mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
  const rows: string[] = [];
  for (const s of INVOICE_SAMPLES) {
    const cells: string[] = [];
    for (const v of ["header", "non-header"] as ReportVariant[]) {
      const name = `${s.id}-${v}`;
      writeFileSync(join(out, `${name}.html`), await renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice: s.invoice, variant: v }));
      writeFileSync(join(out, `${name}.pdf`), await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice: s.invoice, variant: v }));
      cells.push(`<td><a href="${name}.html">HTML</a> · <a href="${name}.pdf">PDF</a></td>`);
    }
    rows.push(`<tr><td><b>${s.invoice.invoiceNo}</b><br><small>${s.label}</small></td>${cells.join("")}</tr>`);
    console.log(`${s.id.padEnd(20)} html + pdf`);
  }
  writeFileSync(
    join(out, "index.html"),
    `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>MGPL Invoice Examples</title>
<style>body{font-family:system-ui,Segoe UI,sans-serif;margin:0;padding:24px 16px;background:#f5f6f8;color:#1c2230}h1{color:#14264A;font-size:22px}
table{border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff;width:100%;max-width:820px}th,td{padding:10px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #e4e7ec;text-align:left;font-size:14px}
th{background:#14264A;color:#fff}small{color:#667085}a{color:#14264A}</style></head><body>
<h1>MGPL Invoice Examples</h1><table><thead><tr><th>Invoice</th><th>Header</th><th>Non-header</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.join("")}</tbody></table></body></html>`,
  );
  console.log("\nWrote examples/index.html");
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error(e);
  process.exit(1);
});
```

## File: scripts/llms-full.mjs

````js
// Builds llms-full.txt: every doc and source file of the repo in one plain-text document for AI tools.
//   node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> [file-or-folder …]
// Folders are walked recursively. Output order: README, AGENTS, docs, then the rest alphabetically.
// Skipped: build output, dependencies, lockfiles, generated files, binaries. Files over 150 KB are
// listed (path + size) instead of inlined. CI checks the file is up to date (`npm run llms` + git diff).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { extname, join, relative } from "node:path";

const [title, ...inputs] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!title || !inputs.length) {
  console.error('usage: node scripts/llms-full.mjs "<title>" <file-or-folder> …');
  process.exit(1);
}

const TEXT = new Set([".ts", ".tsx", ".mts", ".cts", ".js", ".mjs", ".cjs", ".md", ".mdx", ".json", ".css", ".yml", ".yaml", ".txt", ".graphql", ".gql", ".sql", ".html"]);
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(["node_modules", "dist", ".next", ".git", ".turbo", "coverage", "examples", ".pg-test"]);
const SKIP_FILES = /(^|\/)(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock|llms-full\.txt|[^/]*\.generated\.[^/]+|[^/]*\.log)$/;
const MAX = 150 * 1024;
const LANG = { ".ts": "ts", ".tsx": "tsx", ".mts": "ts", ".cts": "ts", ".js": "js", ".mjs": "js", ".cjs": "js", ".json": "json", ".css": "css", ".yml": "yaml", ".yaml": "yaml", ".graphql": "graphql", ".gql": "graphql", ".sql": "sql", ".html": "html" };

const posix = (p) => p.split("\\").join("/");
const files = new Set();
function walk(p) {
  const st = statSync(p);
  if (st.isDirectory()) {
    for (const name of readdirSync(p)) if (!SKIP_DIRS.has(name)) walk(join(p, name));
  } else if (TEXT.has(extname(p).toLowerCase()) && !SKIP_FILES.test(posix(p))) {
    files.add(posix(relative(".", p)));
  }
}
for (const input of inputs) walk(input);

const rank = (f) => (/^README\.md$/i.test(f) ? 0 : /^AGENTS\.md$/i.test(f) ? 1 : /^docs\//.test(f) ? 2 : 3);
const ordered = [...files].sort((a, b) => rank(a) - rank(b) || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

const parts = [`# ${title} — full documentation and source\n\n> Generated by scripts/llms-full.mjs. Do not edit by hand. ${ordered.length} files.\n\n## Contents\n\n${ordered.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join("\n")}\n`];
const omitted = [];
for (const f of ordered) {
  // LF-normalised text, so Windows and Linux checkouts produce byte-identical output
  const body = readFileSync(f, "utf8").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  const size = Buffer.byteLength(body);
  if (size > MAX) {
    omitted.push(`${f} (${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB)`);
    parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n_Omitted: ${(size / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB. Read the file directly._\n`);
    continue;
  }
  const lang = LANG[extname(f).toLowerCase()];
  const fence = body.includes("```") ? "````" : "```";
  parts.push(`\n\n---\n\n## File: ${f}\n\n${lang ? `${fence}${lang}\n${body}\n${fence}` : body}\n`);
}
const out = parts.join("");
writeFileSync("llms-full.txt", out);
console.log(`llms-full.txt: ${ordered.length} files, ${(out.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB${omitted.length ? `; omitted (too large): ${omitted.join(", ")}` : ""}`);
````

## File: scripts/smoke-test.tsx

```tsx
// Invoice smoke test:  npm run smoke
//  1. arithmetic — hand-checked totals, discounts, GST, round-off, paid/due/status, amount in words
//  2. rendering  — every sample × header/non-header as HTML and Node PDF, same page count
//  3. fit        — every printed text fits its column (real Manrope metrics); every glyph exists
import { join } from "node:path";
import * as fontkit from "fontkit";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { MGPL_LAB, type ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { assetsDir } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { amountInWords, buildInvoice, computeInvoice, INVOICE_LAYOUT, INVOICE_SAMPLES, InvoiceDocument, invoicePages, type Invoice } from "../src";
import { renderInvoicePdf } from "../src";
import { cellText, invoiceCard, invoiceColumns, invoiceQr, invoiceRows, noteLines, patientCard, subLine, totalLines, wordsOf } from "../src/model";

const problems: string[] = [];
const warn = (m: string) => problems.push(m);
const eq = (what: string, got: unknown, want: unknown) => {
  if (JSON.stringify(got) !== JSON.stringify(want)) warn(`${what}: got ${JSON.stringify(got)}, expected ${JSON.stringify(want)}`);
};
const patient = { name: "Test", age: 30, sex: "Male" };

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- 1. arithmetic */
{
  // 2 × 150 + 1 × 99.99, 10% bill discount, no tax: 399.99 − 40.00 = 359.99 → rounds to 360
  const inv = buildInvoice({
    invoiceNo: "T1", patient,
    items: [{ name: "A", category: "test", rate: 150, qty: 2 }, { name: "B", category: "test", rate: 99.99 }],
    discount: { percent: 10 },
    payments: [{ mode: "Cash", amount: 100 }],
  });
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  eq("T1 subtotal", t.subtotal, 399.99);
  eq("T1 bill discount", t.billDiscount, 40);
  eq("T1 round off", t.roundOff, 0.01);
  eq("T1 total", t.total, 360);
  eq("T1 due", t.due, 260);
  eq("T1 status", t.status, "PARTIALLY PAID");
  eq("T1 discount shares add up", Math.round(t.lines.reduce((a, l) => a + l.billDiscount, 0) * 100), 4000);
}
{
  // GST after discount: 100 @12% with 10% line discount → 90 + 10.80 = 100.80 → 101; plus untaxed 50
  const inv = buildInvoice({
    invoiceNo: "T2", patient, roundOff: true,
    items: [{ name: "Syringe", category: "consumable", rate: 100, taxPercent: 12, discountPercent: 10 }, { name: "Test", category: "test", rate: 50 }],
    payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 200 }],
  });
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  eq("T2 tax", t.tax, 10.8);
  eq("T2 taxable", t.taxable, 140);
  eq("T2 total", t.total, 151);
  eq("T2 excess", t.excess, 49);
  eq("T2 status", t.status, "PAID");
  eq("T2 tax by rate", t.taxByRate, [{ rate: 12, taxable: 90, tax: 10.8 }]);
}
{
  const t = computeInvoice(buildInvoice({ invoiceNo: "T3", patient, items: [{ name: "x", category: "test", rate: 10.5 }], roundOff: false }));
  eq("T3 no round-off", [t.total, t.roundOff, t.status], [10.5, 0, "DUE"]);
}
for (const [n, w] of [
  [0, "Rupees Zero Only"],
  [15, "Rupees Fifteen Only"],
  [100, "Rupees One Hundred Only"],
  [1001, "Rupees One Thousand One Only"],
  [100000, "Rupees One Lakh Only"],
  [123456.78, "Rupees One Lakh Twenty Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty Six and Seventy Eight Paise Only"],
  [12345678, "Rupees One Crore Twenty Three Lakh Forty Five Thousand Six Hundred Seventy Eight Only"],
] as const)
  eq(`words ${n}`, amountInWords(n), w);

/* ---------------------------------------------------------- 3. fit + glyphs */
const fontDir = join(assetsDir(), "report-fonts");
const mr = { 400: fontkit.openSync(join(fontDir, "manrope-400.woff")) as fontkit.Font, 600: fontkit.openSync(join(fontDir, "manrope-600.woff")) as fontkit.Font, 700: fontkit.openSync(join(fontDir, "manrope-700.woff")) as fontkit.Font, 800: fontkit.openSync(join(fontDir, "manrope-800.woff")) as fontkit.Font };
const width = (f: fontkit.Font, s: string, size: number, ls = 0) => ((f.layout(s).advanceWidth / f.unitsPerEm) * size + ls * s.length) / 72;
const { INV_CELL_PAD, INV_CARDS, INV_TOTALS, INV_ROWS } = INVOICE_LAYOUT;
const pad = 2 * INV_CELL_PAD;

function checkInvoice(id: string, inv: Invoice) {
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  const cols = invoiceColumns(t);
  const texts: string[] = [];
  for (const c of cols) {
    texts.push(c.header);
    if (width(mr[700], c.header.toUpperCase(), 7, 0.4) > c.w - pad + 0.005) warn(`${id}: header "${c.header}" too wide`);
  }
  for (const r of invoiceRows(t)) {
    if (r.kind === "group") continue;
    for (const c of cols) {
      const s = cellText(c, r);
      texts.push(s);
      const f = c.key === "amount" ? mr[700] : c.key === "desc" ? mr[600] : mr[400];
      if (width(f, s, INV_ROWS.fontSize) > c.w - pad + 0.005) warn(`${id}: "${s}" does not fit column ${c.key}`);
    }
    const sub = subLine(r.line);
    if (sub) {
      texts.push(sub);
      if (width(mr[400], sub, 6.6) > cols[1].w - pad) warn(`${id}: sub-line "${sub}" too wide`);
    }
  }
  for (const [card, fields] of [["patient", patientCard(inv)], ["invoice", invoiceCard(inv, t)]] as const) {
    // react-pdf drops text that overflows a fixed-height box, so the rows must fit the card
    const need = fields.length * INV_CARDS.lineH + 2 * INV_CARDS.pad;
    if (need > INV_CARDS.h + 1e-9) warn(`${id}: ${card} card needs ${need.toFixed(3)}in, has ${INV_CARDS.h}in`);
    for (const f of fields) {
      texts.push(f.label, f.value);
      const room = INV_CARDS[card].w - 2 * INV_CARDS.pad - 0.78 - 6 / 72;
      if (width(mr[f.strong ? 800 : 600], f.value, INV_CARDS.valueSize) > room) warn(`${id}: ${card} card "${f.value}" too wide`);
    }
  }
  for (const l of totalLines(inv, t)) {
    texts.push(l.label, l.value);
    const sz = l.kind === "grand" ? 10 : INV_ROWS.fontSize;
    if (width(mr[800], l.label + "  " + l.value, sz) > INV_TOTALS.rightW - pad) warn(`${id}: totals "${l.label} ${l.value}" too wide`);
  }
  for (const n of noteLines(inv, MGPL_LAB)) {
    texts.push(n);
    if (width(mr[400], "• " + n, 7) > INV_TOTALS.rightW + 1.2) warn(`${id}: note "${n}" too wide`);
  }
  // amount in words: 2 lines of the words box
  const words = wordsOf(t);
  texts.push(words, invoiceQr(inv, t, MGPL_LAB).label);
  if (width(mr[700], words, INV_ROWS.fontSize) > 2 * (INVOICE_LAYOUT.INV_W - INV_TOTALS.rightW - INV_TOTALS.gap - 0.2)) warn(`${id}: amount in words needs > 2 lines`);
  for (const ch of new Set(texts.join(" ")))
    if (ch.codePointAt(0)! >= 32 && !mr[400].hasGlyphForCodePoint(ch.codePointAt(0)!)) warn(`${id}: glyph "${ch}" missing from Manrope`);
}

/** All text in a PDF (Mozilla pdf.js), whitespace removed — used to prove values were really drawn. */
async function pdfText(buf: Buffer): Promise<string> {
  const { getDocument } = await import("pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs");
  const task = getDocument({ data: new Uint8Array(buf), disableFontFace: true, verbosity: 0 });
  const doc = await task.promise;
  let out = "";
  for (let p = 1; p <= doc.numPages; p++) {
    const c = await (await doc.getPage(p)).getTextContent();
    out += c.items.map((i) => ("str" in i ? i.str : "")).join("");
  }
  await task.destroy();
  if (out.trim().length < 50) throw new Error("PDF text extraction returned almost nothing");
  return out.replace(/\s+/g, "");
}
const squash = (s: string) => s.replace(/\s+/g, "");

/* ------------------------------------------------------------- 2. rendering */
async function main() {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const variants: ReportVariant[] = ["header", "non-header"];
  let ok = 0;
  for (const s of INVOICE_SAMPLES) {
    checkInvoice(s.id, s.invoice);
    const pages = invoicePages(s.invoice, MGPL_LAB).pages.length;
    for (const v of variants) {
      const tag = `${s.id}/${v}`;
      try {
        const html = renderToStaticMarkup(<InvoiceDocument invoice={s.invoice} variant={v} />);
        const htmlPages = html.split('class="sb-page"').length - 1;
        if (htmlPages !== pages) warn(`${tag}: HTML ${htmlPages} pages, layout ${pages}`);
        if (!html.includes(s.invoice.invoiceNo)) warn(`${tag}: invoice number missing`);
        const hasLetterhead = html.includes('class="sb-side"');
        if ((v === "header") !== hasLetterhead) warn(`${tag}: letterhead ${hasLetterhead ? "printed" : "missing"}`);
        const pdf = await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice: s.invoice, variant: v });
        const pdfPages = (pdf.toString("latin1").match(/\/Type \/Page\b/g) ?? []).length;
        if (pdfPages !== pages) warn(`${tag}: PDF ${pdfPages} pages, layout ${pages}`);
        // every value must really be drawn in the PDF (react-pdf silently drops overflowing text)
        const text = await pdfText(pdf);
        const t = computeInvoice(s.invoice);
        const expect = [
          s.invoice.invoiceNo, s.invoice.patient.name, ...patientCard(s.invoice).map((f) => f.value), ...invoiceCard(s.invoice, t).map((f) => f.value),
          ...s.invoice.items.map((it) => it.name), ...totalLines(s.invoice, t).map((l) => l.value), wordsOf(t),
          ...(s.invoice.payments ?? []).map((p) => p.reference ?? p.mode),
        ];
        for (const v of expect) if (!text.includes(squash(v))) warn(`${tag}: PDF is missing "${v}"`);
        ok++;
        console.log(`ok   ${tag.padEnd(34)} ${pages} page(s)  ${(pdf.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB`);
      } catch (e) {
        warn(`${tag}: threw ${(e as Error).stack}`);
      }
    }
  }
  console.log(`\n${ok}/${INVOICE_SAMPLES.length * 2} invoice renders passed in ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(1)}s.`);
  if (problems.length) {
    console.log(`\n${problems.length} problem(s):`);
    for (const p of problems) console.log("  - " + p);
    process.exit(1);
  }
  console.log("All checks passed.");
}

main();
```

## File: src/InvoiceDocument.tsx

```tsx
import { barcodeSvg, formatDate, MGPL_LAB, qrSvg, SbLetterhead, type LabProfile, type ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { CURRENCY, money, type InvoiceTotals } from "./calc";
import { INV_CARDS, INV_COLORS, INV_PAY_COLS as PC } from "./layout";
import {
  cellText,
  invoiceCard,
  invoiceColumns,
  invoicePages,
  invoiceQr,
  noteLines,
  patientCard,
  rowHeight,
  STATUS_COLOR,
  subLine,
  totalLines,
  wordsOf,
  type CardField,
  type InvColumn,
  type InvRow,
} from "./model";
import { invoiceCss } from "./styles";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

export interface InvoiceDocumentProps {
  invoice: Invoice;
  /** "header" prints the letterhead; "non-header" leaves it to pre-printed paper. */
  variant: ReportVariant;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  includeStyles?: boolean;
  /** URL folder with the report-kit fonts (default "/report-fonts") */
  fontBase?: string;
}

const inch = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const Svg = ({ className, svg }: { className: string; svg: string }) => <div className={className} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: svg }} />;

/** A4 patient invoice (HTML). Pure component — works in Server/Client Components and renderToStaticMarkup. */
export function InvoiceDocument({ invoice, variant, lab = MGPL_LAB, includeStyles = true, fontBase }: InvoiceDocumentProps) {
  const { pages, totals } = invoicePages(invoice, lab);
  const cols = invoiceColumns(totals);
  const bar = barcodeSvg(invoice.invoiceNo, "code128");
  const qr = invoiceQr(invoice, totals, lab);
  const qrMarkup = qrSvg(qr.value);
  const signature = variant === "header" ? lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc;

  return (
    <div className="sb-doc">
      {includeStyles && <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: invoiceCss(fontBase) }} />}
      {pages.map((page, n) => (
        <div key={n} className="sb-page">
          {variant === "header" && <SbLetterhead lab={lab} />}

          <div className="iv-title">
            <div>
              <h1>{invoice.title ?? "INVOICE"}</h1>
              <small>
                {[lab.gstin && `GSTIN: ${lab.gstin}`, lab.registrationNo && `Reg. No: ${lab.registrationNo}`].filter(Boolean).join("   •   ") ||
                  "Laboratory bill / cash memo"}
                {page.continued ? "   (continued)" : ""}
              </small>
            </div>
            <span className="iv-status" style={{ background: STATUS_COLOR[totals.status] }}>
              {totals.status}
            </span>
          </div>

          <Card x="patient" fields={patientCard(invoice)} />
          <Card x="invoice" fields={invoiceCard(invoice, totals)} />
          {bar && <Svg className="iv-barcode" svg={bar.replace("<svg ", '<svg preserveAspectRatio="none" ')} />}
          <Svg className="iv-qr" svg={qrMarkup} />
          <div className="iv-qr-label">{qr.label}</div>

          <div className="iv-body">
            <div className="iv-row iv-th">
              {cols.map((c) => (
                <div key={c.key} className={`iv-cell ${c.align}`} style={{ width: inch(c.w) }}>
                  {c.header}
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            {page.rows.map((r, k) => (
              <RowView key={k} row={r} cols={cols} />
            ))}
            {page.totals && <Totals invoice={invoice} totals={totals} lab={lab} />}
          </div>

          <img className="sb-abs iv-signimg" src={signature} alt="Signature" />
          <div className="iv-signname">
            <b>For {lab.name}</b>
            <span>Authorised Signatory</span>
          </div>
          <div className="iv-legal">
            <span>This is a computer-generated invoice. {formatDate(invoice.date)}</span>
            <span>
              Page {n + 1} of {pages.length}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Card({ x, fields }: { x: "patient" | "invoice"; fields: CardField[] }) {
  return (
    <div className="iv-card" style={{ left: inch(INV_CARDS[x].x), width: inch(INV_CARDS[x].w) }}>
      {fields.map((f) => (
        <div key={f.label} className="iv-field">
          <span>{f.label}</span>
          <b className={f.strong ? "strong" : undefined}>{f.value}</b>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function RowView({ row, cols }: { row: InvRow; cols: InvColumn[] }) {
  if (row.kind === "group") return <div className="iv-group">{row.label}</div>;
  const sub = subLine(row.line);
  return (
    <div className="iv-row" style={{ height: `${rowHeight(row)}pt` }}>
      {cols.map((c) => (
        <div key={c.key} className={`iv-cell ${c.align}`} style={{ width: inch(c.w) }}>
          <span className={c.key === "disc" ? "iv-disc" : undefined} style={c.key === "desc" || c.key === "amount" ? { fontWeight: c.key === "amount" ? 700 : 600 } : undefined}>
            {cellText(c, row)}
          </span>
          {c.key === "desc" && sub && <span className="iv-sub">{sub}</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Totals({ invoice, totals, lab }: { invoice: Invoice; totals: InvoiceTotals; lab: LabProfile }) {
  const pays = invoice.payments ?? [];
  const notes = noteLines(invoice, lab);
  return (
    <div className="iv-totals">
      <div className="iv-left">
        <div className="iv-words">
          <span>Amount in words</span>
          <b>{wordsOf(totals)}</b>
        </div>
        <div className="iv-pays">
          <div className="iv-row iv-ph">
            <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.date) }}>Date</div>
            <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.mode) }}>Mode</div>
            <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.ref) }}>Reference</div>
            <div className="iv-cell right" style={{ width: inch(PC.amount) }}>Amount ({CURRENCY})</div>
          </div>
          {pays.length ? (
            pays.map((p, k) => (
              <div key={k} className="iv-row">
                <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.date) }}>{formatDate(p.date ?? invoice.date)}</div>
                <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.mode) }}>{p.mode}</div>
                <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.ref) }}>{p.reference ?? "-"}</div>
                <div className="iv-cell right" style={{ width: inch(PC.amount), fontWeight: 700 }}>{money(p.amount)}</div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : (
            <div className="iv-row">
              <div className="iv-cell left" style={{ width: inch(PC.date + PC.mode + PC.ref + PC.amount), color: INV_COLORS.muted }}>No payment received yet</div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        {notes.length > 0 && (
          <div className="iv-notes">
            <h4>Notes &amp; terms</h4>
            {notes.map((n, k) => (
              <p key={k}>• {n}</p>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <div className="iv-right">
        {totalLines(invoice, totals).map((l) => (
          <div key={l.label} className={`iv-tl${l.kind ? " " + l.kind : ""}`} style={l.kind === "due" ? { color: totals.due > 0 || totals.excess > 0 ? INV_COLORS.due : INV_COLORS.paid } : undefined}>
            <span>{l.label}</span>
            <span>{l.value}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

import { Document, Image, Page, Text, View } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { formatDate, type LabProfile, type ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { SbLetterheadPdf, type SbPdfImages } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { CURRENCY, money, type InvoiceTotals } from "./calc";
import {
  INV_BODY,
  INV_CARDS as K,
  INV_CELL_PAD,
  INV_COLORS as C,
  INV_FONT,
  INV_LEGAL,
  INV_PAY_COLS as PC,
  INV_RIGHT,
  INV_ROWS as R,
  INV_SIGN,
  INV_TITLE,
  INV_TOTALS,
  INV_W,
  INV_X,
} from "./layout";
import {
  cellText,
  invoiceCard,
  invoiceColumns,
  invoicePages,
  invoiceQr,
  noteLines,
  patientCard,
  rowHeight,
  STATUS_COLOR,
  subLine,
  totalLines,
  wordsOf,
  type CardField,
  type InvColumn,
  type InvRow,
} from "./model";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

type Img = SbPdfImages["logo"];
export interface InvoicePdfImages {
  logo: Img;
  email: Img;
  phone: Img;
  signature: Img;
  barcode?: Img;
  qr: Img;
}

const i = (n: number) => `${n}in`;
const justify = (a: "left" | "center" | "right") => (a === "left" ? "flex-start" : a === "right" ? "flex-end" : "center");

/** Patient invoice as a react-pdf Document — same geometry and page breaks as <InvoiceDocument/>. */
export function InvoicePdf({ invoice, variant, lab, images }: { invoice: Invoice; variant: ReportVariant; lab: LabProfile; images: InvoicePdfImages }) {
  const { pages, totals } = invoicePages(invoice, lab);
  const cols = invoiceColumns(totals);
  const qr = invoiceQr(invoice, totals, lab);
  const sub = [lab.gstin && `GSTIN: ${lab.gstin}`, lab.registrationNo && `Reg. No: ${lab.registrationNo}`].filter(Boolean).join("   •   ") || "Laboratory bill / cash memo";
  return (
    <Document title={`Invoice ${invoice.invoiceNo}`} author={lab.name} creator={lab.name} producer={lab.name}>
      {pages.map((page, n) => (
        <Page key={n} size="A4" style={{ fontFamily: INV_FONT, fontSize: R.fontSize, color: C.ink }}>
          {variant === "header" && <SbLetterheadPdf lab={lab} images={images} />}

          {/* title + status */}
          <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_X), width: i(INV_W), top: i(INV_TITLE.y), height: i(INV_TITLE.h), flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center" }}>
            <View>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: INV_TITLE.size, fontWeight: 800, color: C.navy, letterSpacing: 1.3, lineHeight: 1 }}>{invoice.title ?? "INVOICE"}</Text>
              <Text style={{ fontSize: INV_TITLE.subSize, color: C.muted, fontWeight: 500, marginTop: 3 }}>{`${sub}${page.continued ? "   (continued)" : ""}`}</Text>
            </View>
            <View style={{ backgroundColor: STATUS_COLOR[totals.status], borderRadius: 20, paddingVertical: 4, paddingHorizontal: 10 }}>
              <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontWeight: 800, fontSize: 8, letterSpacing: 0.8 }}>{totals.status}</Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <Card at={K.patient} fields={patientCard(invoice)} />
          <Card at={K.invoice} fields={invoiceCard(invoice, totals)} />
          {images.barcode && (
            <Image src={images.barcode} style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_RIGHT - K.barcode.w), top: i(K.y), width: i(K.barcode.w), height: i(K.barcode.h), objectFit: "fill" }} />
          )}
          <Image src={images.qr} style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_RIGHT - K.barcode.w / 2 - K.qr.s / 2), top: i(K.y + K.barcode.h + 0.04), width: i(K.qr.s), height: i(K.qr.s) }} />
          <Text
            style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_RIGHT - K.barcode.w - 0.1), width: i(K.barcode.w + 0.1), top: i(K.y + K.barcode.h + 0.06 + K.qr.s), textAlign: "center", fontSize: K.qr.labelSize, color: C.muted }}
          >
            {qr.label}
          </Text>

          {/* items */}
          <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_X), width: i(INV_W), top: i(INV_BODY.top) }}>
            <View style={{ height: R.tableHeader, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", backgroundColor: C.navy, borderTopLeftRadius: 3, borderTopRightRadius: 3 }}>
              {cols.map((c) => (
                <Cell key={c.key} w={c.w} align={c.align}>
                  <Text style={{ color: "#fff", fontSize: 7, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.4 }}>{c.header.toUpperCase()}</Text>
                </Cell>
              ))}
            </View>
            {page.rows.map((r, k) => (
              <RowView key={k} row={r} cols={cols} />
            ))}
            {page.totals && <Totals invoice={invoice} totals={totals} lab={lab} />}
          </View>

          {/* signature + legal */}
          <Image
            src={images.signature}
            style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_SIGN.centerX - INV_SIGN.sign.w / 2), top: i(INV_SIGN.sign.y), width: i(INV_SIGN.sign.w), height: i(INV_SIGN.sign.h), objectFit: "contain" }}
          />
          <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(INV_SIGN.centerX - 1.3), width: i(2.6), top: i(INV_SIGN.nameY) }}>
            <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: INV_SIGN.nameSize, fontWeight: 800 }}>{`For ${lab.name}`}</Text>
            <Text style={{ textAlign: "center", fontSize: INV_SIGN.roleSize, color: C.muted }}>Authorised Signatory</Text>
          </View>
          <View
            style={{
              position: "absolute",
              left: i(INV_X),
              width: i(INV_W),
              top: i(INV_LEGAL.y),
              flexDirection: "row",
              justifyContent: "space-between",
              borderTopWidth: 0.5,
              borderTopColor: C.line,
              paddingTop: 3,
              fontSize: INV_LEGAL.size,
              color: C.muted,
            }}
          >
            <Text>{`This is a computer-generated invoice. ${formatDate(invoice.date)}`}</Text>
            <Text>{`Page ${n + 1} of ${pages.length}`}</Text>
          </View>
        </Page>
      ))}
    </Document>
  );
}

function Card({ at, fields }: { at: { x: number; w: number }; fields: CardField[] }) {
  return (
    <View style={{ position: "absolute", left: i(at.x), width: i(at.w), top: i(K.y), height: i(K.h), backgroundColor: C.card, borderRadius: 6, padding: i(K.pad) }}>
      {fields.map((f) => (
        <View key={f.label} style={{ height: i(K.lineH), flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center" }}>
          {/* lineHeight 1 keeps each text inside its fixed-height row — react-pdf drops text that overflows */}
          <View style={{ width: 0.78 * 72 + 6 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: K.labelSize, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.35, color: C.muted, lineHeight: 1 }}>{f.label.toUpperCase()}</Text>
          </View>
          <View style={{ width: (at.w - 2 * K.pad - 0.78) * 72 - 6 }}>
            <Text style={{ fontSize: K.valueSize, fontWeight: f.strong ? 800 : 600, lineHeight: 1 }}>{f.value}</Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function Cell({ w, align, children }: { w: number; align: "left" | "center" | "right"; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return <View style={{ width: i(w), height: "100%", paddingHorizontal: i(INV_CELL_PAD), justifyContent: "center", alignItems: justify(align) }}>{children}</View>;
}

function RowView({ row, cols }: { row: InvRow; cols: InvColumn[] }) {
  if (row.kind === "group") {
    return (
      <View style={{ height: R.group, justifyContent: "flex-end", paddingHorizontal: i(INV_CELL_PAD), paddingBottom: 2, borderBottomWidth: 0.5, borderBottomColor: C.line }}>
        <Text style={{ fontWeight: 800, color: C.navy, fontSize: 7.5, letterSpacing: 0.45 }}>{row.label.toUpperCase()}</Text>
      </View>
    );
  }
  const sub = subLine(row.line);
  return (
    <View style={{ height: rowHeight(row), flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", borderBottomWidth: 0.5, borderBottomColor: C.line }}>
      {cols.map((c) => (
        <Cell key={c.key} w={c.w} align={c.align}>
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: c.key === "amount" ? 700 : c.key === "desc" ? 600 : 400, color: c.key === "disc" ? C.saffron : undefined }}>{cellText(c, row)}</Text>
          {c.key === "desc" && sub ? <Text style={{ fontSize: 6.6, color: C.muted }}>{sub}</Text> : null}
        </Cell>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

function Totals({ invoice, totals, lab }: { invoice: Invoice; totals: InvoiceTotals; lab: LabProfile }) {
  const pays = invoice.payments ?? [];
  const notes = noteLines(invoice, lab);
  const label = { fontSize: 6.5, fontWeight: 700, letterSpacing: 0.33, color: C.muted } as const;
  const payRow = (cells: [string, number, "left" | "right", boolean?][], h: number, header = false) => (
    <View style={{ height: h, flexDirection: "row", alignItems: "center", borderBottomWidth: header ? 0.8 : 0.5, borderBottomColor: header ? C.navy : C.line }}>
      {cells.map(([t, w, a, bold], k) => (
        <Cell key={k} w={w} align={a}>
          <Text style={header ? label : { fontWeight: bold ? 700 : 400 }}>{header ? t.toUpperCase() : t}</Text>
        </Cell>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
  return (
    <View style={{ flexDirection: "row", justifyContent: "space-between", marginTop: R.totalsGap }}>
      <View style={{ width: i(INV_W - INV_TOTALS.rightW - INV_TOTALS.gap) }}>
        <View style={{ height: R.wordsBox, backgroundColor: C.card, borderRadius: 4, paddingVertical: 4, paddingHorizontal: i(INV_CELL_PAD + 0.02) }}>
          <Text style={label}>AMOUNT IN WORDS</Text>
          <Text style={{ fontWeight: 700, lineHeight: 1.3 }}>{wordsOf(totals)}</Text>
        </View>
        <View style={{ marginTop: R.blockGap }}>
          {payRow(
            [
              ["Date", PC.date, "left"],
              ["Mode", PC.mode, "left"],
              ["Reference", PC.ref, "left"],
              [`Amount (${CURRENCY})`, PC.amount, "right"],
            ],
            R.payHeader,
            true,
          )}
          {pays.length
            ? pays.map((p, k) => (
                <View key={k}>
                  {payRow(
                    [
                      [formatDate(p.date ?? invoice.date), PC.date, "left"],
                      [p.mode, PC.mode, "left"],
                      [p.reference ?? "-", PC.ref, "left"],
                      [money(p.amount), PC.amount, "right", true],
                    ],
                    R.payRow,
                  )}
                </View>
              ))
            : payRow([["No payment received yet", PC.date + PC.mode + PC.ref + PC.amount, "left"]], R.payRow)}
        </View>
        {notes.length > 0 && (
          <View style={{ marginTop: R.blockGap }}>
            <View style={{ height: R.noteTitle, justifyContent: "center" }}>
              <Text style={label}>NOTES &amp; TERMS</Text>
            </View>
            {notes.map((t, k) => (
              <View key={k} style={{ height: R.noteLine, justifyContent: "center" }}>
                <Text style={{ fontSize: 7 }}>{`• ${t}`}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>
        )}
      </View>
      <View style={{ width: i(INV_TOTALS.rightW) }}>
        {totalLines(invoice, totals).map((l) => {
          const grand = l.kind === "grand";
          const color = l.kind === "muted" ? C.muted : l.kind === "paid" ? C.paid : l.kind === "due" ? (totals.due > 0 || totals.excess > 0 ? C.due : C.paid) : grand ? "#fff" : C.ink;
          return (
            <View
              key={l.label}
              style={{
                height: grand ? R.grand - 4 : R.totalsRow,
                marginVertical: grand ? 2 : 0,
                flexDirection: "row",
                justifyContent: "space-between",
                alignItems: "center",
                paddingHorizontal: i(INV_CELL_PAD),
                backgroundColor: grand ? C.navy : undefined,
                borderRadius: grand ? 3 : 0,
              }}
            >
              <Text style={{ color, fontWeight: grand || l.kind === "due" ? 800 : l.kind === "paid" ? 700 : 400, fontSize: grand ? 10 : undefined }}>{l.label}</Text>
              <Text style={{ color, fontWeight: grand || l.kind === "due" ? 800 : l.kind === "paid" ? 700 : 400, fontSize: grand ? 10 : undefined }}>{l.value}</Text>
            </View>
          );
        })}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

## File: src/api.ts

```ts
// Invoice routes + createMgplApi(): ONE backend handler for reports AND invoices.
import {
  apiBaseUrl,
  createReportApi,
  DEFAULT_BASE_PATH,
  HttpError,
  htmlResponse,
  json,
  labWithAssetUrls,
  defaultLab,
  pdfResponse,
  readJson,
  withCors,
  type ApiHandler,
  type ApiOptions,
  type ReportVariant,
} from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { buildInvoice, type BuildInvoiceInput } from "./build";
import { amountInWords, computeInvoice } from "./calc";
import { renderInvoicePdf } from "./pdf";
import { PRICE_LIST } from "./price-list";
import { INVOICE_SAMPLES } from "./samples";
import { renderInvoiceHtml } from "./server";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

export const INVOICE_ROUTES = { invoice: "/invoice", priceList: "/price-list", invoiceSamples: "/invoice-samples" } as const;

/** POST /invoice body */
export interface InvoiceRequest {
  /** Same shape as buildInvoice(): items may be price-list codes, code + overrides, or full items */
  invoice?: BuildInvoiceInput;
  /** demo id (only when the server enables samples) */
  sample?: string;
  variant?: ReportVariant;
  /** default "pdf"; "json" returns the calculation */
  format?: "pdf" | "html" | "json";
  fileName?: string;
  download?: boolean;
}

const num = (v: unknown) => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v);

/** Validates and builds an Invoice from a request (HttpError 400 on bad input). */
export function invoiceFromRequest(body: InvoiceRequest, opts: Pick<ApiOptions, "samples"> = {}): Invoice {
  try {
    if (body.sample) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new Error("samples are disabled on this server");
      const s = INVOICE_SAMPLES.find((x) => x.id === body.sample);
      if (!s) throw new Error(`unknown sample "${body.sample}"`);
      return s.invoice;
    }
    const inv = body.invoice;
    if (!inv) throw new Error("send invoice or sample");
    if (!inv.invoiceNo || typeof inv.invoiceNo !== "string") throw new Error("invoice.invoiceNo is required");
    if (!inv.patient?.name || inv.patient.age == null || !inv.patient.sex) throw new Error("invoice.patient needs name, age and sex");
    if (!Array.isArray(inv.items) || !inv.items.length) throw new Error("invoice.items must be a non-empty array");
    if (inv.items.length > 500) throw new Error("too many items");
    const built = buildInvoice(inv);
    for (const [k, it] of built.items.entries()) {
      if (!num(it.rate) || it.rate < 0) throw new Error(`items[${k}].rate must be a number >= 0`);
      if (it.qty != null && (!num(it.qty) || it.qty <= 0)) throw new Error(`items[${k}].qty must be > 0`);
      if (it.taxPercent != null && (!num(it.taxPercent) || it.taxPercent < 0 || it.taxPercent > 100)) throw new Error(`items[${k}].taxPercent must be 0-100`);
    }
    for (const [k, p] of (built.payments ?? []).entries()) if (!num(p.amount) || p.amount < 0) throw new Error(`payments[${k}].amount must be a number >= 0`);
    return built;
  } catch (e) {
    throw new HttpError(400, (e as Error).message);
  }
}

/** The server's calculation as JSON (what POST /invoice returns with format "json"). */
export function invoiceTotalsJson(inv: Invoice) {
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  return {
    ...t,
    lines: t.lines.map((l) => ({
      index: l.index,
      name: l.item.name,
      qty: l.qty,
      gross: l.gross,
      lineDiscount: l.lineDiscount,
      billDiscount: l.billDiscount,
      taxable: l.taxable,
      tax: l.tax,
      amount: l.amount,
    })),
    amountInWords: amountInWords(t.total),
  };
}

/** Invoice routes only. Returns null for paths it doesn't own (so it can be combined). */
export function createInvoiceRoutes(opts: ApiOptions = {}) {
  const base = (opts.basePath ?? DEFAULT_BASE_PATH).replace(/\/$/, "");
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const max = opts.maxBodyBytes ?? 1_000_000;
  return async (req: Request): Promise<Response | null> => {
    let path = new URL(req.url).pathname;
    if (path.startsWith(base)) path = path.slice(base.length) || "/";
    const get = req.method === "GET" || req.method === "HEAD";
    if (path === INVOICE_ROUTES.priceList && get) return json(Object.entries(PRICE_LIST).map(([code, e]) => ({ code, ...e })));
    if (path === INVOICE_ROUTES.invoiceSamples && get) {
      if (!opts.samples) throw new HttpError(404, "samples are disabled on this server");
      return json(INVOICE_SAMPLES.map((s) => ({ id: s.id, label: s.label, invoiceNo: s.invoice.invoiceNo })));
    }
    if (path !== INVOICE_ROUTES.invoice) return null;
    if (req.method !== "POST") throw new HttpError(405, "Use POST");
    const body = await readJson<InvoiceRequest>(req, max);
    const invoice = invoiceFromRequest(body, opts);
    const variant: ReportVariant = body.variant === "non-header" ? "non-header" : "header";
    if (body.format === "json") return json(invoiceTotalsJson(invoice));
    if (body.format === "html") {
      const assetBase = apiBaseUrl(req, opts) + "/assets";
      return htmlResponse(await renderInvoiceHtml({ invoice, variant, lab: labWithAssetUrls(lab, assetBase), inline: false, fontBase: `${assetBase}/report-fonts` }));
    }
    return pdfResponse(await renderInvoicePdf({ invoice, variant, lab }), body.fileName ?? `${invoice.invoiceNo}.pdf`, !!body.download);
  };
}

/**
 * ONE backend for reports + invoices (all report-kit routes plus /invoice, /price-list).
 *
 *   // Next.js  app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts
 *   const api = createMgplApi();
 *   export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };  export const runtime = "nodejs";
 *
 *   // Fastify   app.register(mgplFastify, { prefix: "/api/mgpl" })      (from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit/fastify")
 *   // Express   app.use("/api/mgpl", toNodeHandler(createMgplApi()))
 */
export function createMgplApi(opts: ApiOptions = {}): ApiHandler {
  const reports = createReportApi(opts);
  const invoices = createInvoiceRoutes(opts);
  return async (req) => {
    if (req.method === "OPTIONS") return reports(req);
    try {
      const res = await invoices(req);
      if (res) return withCors(res, opts.cors);
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof HttpError) return withCors(json({ error: e.message }, e.status), opts.cors);
      console.error("[@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit]", e);
      return withCors(json({ error: "Internal error" }, 500), opts.cors);
    }
    return reports(req);
  };
}
```

## File: src/build.ts

```ts
import type { Patient } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { PRICE_LIST, type PriceEntry } from "./price-list";
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem, Payment } from "./types";

/** A line given by price-list code (with optional overrides) or written out in full. */
export type ItemInput = string | (Partial<InvoiceItem> & { code: string }) | InvoiceItem;

export interface BuildInvoiceInput {
  invoiceNo: string;
  date?: Date | string;
  patient: Patient;
  items: ItemInput[];
  discount?: Invoice["discount"];
  payments?: Payment[];
  notes?: string[];
  roundOff?: boolean;
  title?: string;
  /** Use a different price list (defaults to PRICE_LIST) */
  priceList?: Record<string, PriceEntry>;
}

/**
 *   buildInvoice({
 *     invoiceNo: "INV-2026-0042", patient,
 *     items: ["cbc", "lft", { code: "home-collection" }, { code: "syringe-5ml", qty: 2 }],
 *     discount: { percent: 10, reason: "Senior citizen" },
 *     payments: [{ mode: "UPI", amount: 500, reference: "UTR 4521…" }],
 *   })
 */
export function buildInvoice(input: BuildInvoiceInput): Invoice {
  const list = input.priceList ?? PRICE_LIST;
  const items = input.items.map((it): InvoiceItem => {
    if (typeof it === "string") it = { code: it };
    if ("name" in it && "rate" in it && "category" in it && it.name && it.rate != null && it.category) return it as InvoiceItem;
    const code = (it as { code: string }).code;
    const entry = list[code];
    if (!entry) throw new Error(`Unknown price-list code "${code}"`);
    return { ...entry, ...it, code } as InvoiceItem;
  });
  return {
    invoiceNo: input.invoiceNo,
    date: input.date,
    patient: input.patient,
    items,
    discount: input.discount,
    payments: input.payments,
    notes: input.notes,
    roundOff: input.roundOff,
    title: input.title,
  };
}

/** Bill the tests on a report: template / profile ids → invoice lines. */
export const itemsForTests = (ids: string[]): ItemInput[] => ids.map((code) => ({ code }));
```

## File: src/calc.ts

```ts
// Invoice arithmetic. Everything is done in integer paise so totals never drift by a paisa.
import type { Invoice, InvoiceItem, PaymentStatus } from "./types";

const P = (rupees: number) => Math.round(rupees * 100);
const R = (paise: number) => paise / 100;

export interface ComputedLine {
  item: InvoiceItem;
  index: number;
  qty: number;
  /** qty × rate */
  gross: number;
  lineDiscount: number;
  /** share of the bill-level discount */
  billDiscount: number;
  /** gross − discounts */
  taxable: number;
  tax: number;
  /** taxable + tax */
  amount: number;
}

export interface InvoiceTotals {
  lines: ComputedLine[];
  /** Σ qty × rate */
  subtotal: number;
  lineDiscount: number;
  billDiscount: number;
  taxable: number;
  tax: number;
  /** tax grouped by rate, e.g. [{ rate: 12, taxable: 100, tax: 12 }] */
  taxByRate: { rate: number; taxable: number; tax: number }[];
  roundOff: number;
  total: number;
  paid: number;
  /** total − paid, never negative */
  due: number;
  /** paid − total when overpaid (refund / change) */
  excess: number;
  status: PaymentStatus;
  hasTax: boolean;
  hasDiscount: boolean;
}

export function computeInvoice(inv: Invoice): InvoiceTotals {
  // 1. line gross and line discount
  const base = inv.items.map((item, index) => {
    const qty = item.qty ?? 1;
    const gross = Math.round(qty * P(item.rate));
    const disc =
      item.discountPercent != null ? Math.round((gross * item.discountPercent) / 100) : Math.min(gross, P(item.discountAmount ?? 0));
    return { item, index, qty, gross, lineDiscount: disc, afterLine: gross - disc };
  });

  // 2. bill discount, shared in proportion to each line's value (largest-remainder so it adds up exactly)
  const pool = base.reduce((a, l) => a + l.afterLine, 0);
  const wanted = inv.discount?.percent != null ? Math.round((pool * inv.discount.percent) / 100) : P(inv.discount?.amount ?? 0);
  const billTotal = Math.min(pool, Math.max(0, wanted));
  const shares = base.map((l) => (pool ? (billTotal * l.afterLine) / pool : 0));
  const floors = shares.map(Math.floor);
  let left = billTotal - floors.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  shares
    .map((s, i) => ({ i, frac: s - Math.floor(s) }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.frac - a.frac)
    .forEach(({ i }) => {
      if (left > 0) {
        floors[i]++;
        left--;
      }
    });

  // 3. tax on what is left
  const lines = base.map((l, i) => {
    const taxable = l.afterLine - floors[i];
    const tax = Math.round((taxable * (l.item.taxPercent ?? 0)) / 100);
    return { ...l, billDiscount: floors[i], taxable, tax, amount: taxable + tax };
  });

  const sum = (f: (l: (typeof lines)[number]) => number) => lines.reduce((a, l) => a + f(l), 0);
  const exact = sum((l) => l.amount);
  const total = inv.roundOff === false ? exact : Math.round(exact / 100) * 100;
  const paid = (inv.payments ?? []).reduce((a, p) => a + P(p.amount), 0);

  const byRate = new Map<number, { taxable: number; tax: number }>();
  for (const l of lines) {
    const rate = l.item.taxPercent ?? 0;
    if (!rate) continue;
    const e = byRate.get(rate) ?? { taxable: 0, tax: 0 };
    e.taxable += l.taxable;
    e.tax += l.tax;
    byRate.set(rate, e);
  }

  const status: PaymentStatus = paid >= total ? "PAID" : paid > 0 ? "PARTIALLY PAID" : "DUE";
  return {
    lines: lines.map((l) => ({
      item: l.item,
      index: l.index,
      qty: l.qty,
      gross: R(l.gross),
      lineDiscount: R(l.lineDiscount),
      billDiscount: R(l.billDiscount),
      taxable: R(l.taxable),
      tax: R(l.tax),
      amount: R(l.amount),
    })),
    subtotal: R(sum((l) => l.gross)),
    lineDiscount: R(sum((l) => l.lineDiscount)),
    billDiscount: R(billTotal),
    taxable: R(sum((l) => l.taxable)),
    tax: R(sum((l) => l.tax)),
    taxByRate: [...byRate.entries()].sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0]).map(([rate, e]) => ({ rate, taxable: R(e.taxable), tax: R(e.tax) })),
    roundOff: R(total - exact),
    total: R(total),
    paid: R(paid),
    due: R(Math.max(0, total - paid)),
    excess: R(Math.max(0, paid - total)),
    status,
    hasTax: lines.some((l) => (l.item.taxPercent ?? 0) > 0),
    hasDiscount: sum((l) => l.lineDiscount) > 0 || billTotal > 0,
  };
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------- formatting */

const inr = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { minimumFractionDigits: 2, maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
/** 123456.5 → "1,23,456.50" (Indian digit grouping) */
export const money = (n: number) => inr.format(n);
export const CURRENCY = "Rs.";

const ONES = ["", "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five", "Six", "Seven", "Eight", "Nine", "Ten", "Eleven", "Twelve", "Thirteen", "Fourteen", "Fifteen", "Sixteen", "Seventeen", "Eighteen", "Nineteen"];
const TENS = ["", "", "Twenty", "Thirty", "Forty", "Fifty", "Sixty", "Seventy", "Eighty", "Ninety"];

function upTo99(n: number) {
  return n < 20 ? ONES[n] : `${TENS[Math.floor(n / 10)]}${n % 10 ? " " + ONES[n % 10] : ""}`;
}
function upTo999(n: number) {
  const h = Math.floor(n / 100);
  const r = n % 100;
  return [h ? `${ONES[h]} Hundred` : "", r ? upTo99(r) : ""].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
}

/** Indian numbering: 123456.78 → "Rupees One Lakh Twenty Three Thousand Four Hundred Fifty Six and Seventy Eight Paise Only" */
export function amountInWords(amount: number): string {
  const paise = Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 100);
  let r = Math.floor(paise / 100);
  const p = paise % 100;
  if (r === 0 && p === 0) return "Rupees Zero Only";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const crore = Math.floor(r / 1e7);
  r %= 1e7;
  const lakh = Math.floor(r / 1e5);
  r %= 1e5;
  const thousand = Math.floor(r / 1000);
  r %= 1000;
  if (crore) parts.push(`${crore >= 100 ? upTo999(crore) : upTo99(crore)} Crore`);
  if (lakh) parts.push(`${upTo99(lakh)} Lakh`);
  if (thousand) parts.push(`${upTo99(thousand)} Thousand`);
  if (r) parts.push(upTo999(r));
  const rupees = parts.length ? `Rupees ${parts.join(" ")}` : "Rupees Zero";
  return `${rupees}${p ? ` and ${upTo99(p)} Paise` : ""} Only`;
}
```

/**
