## File: src/model.ts

```ts
// Display logic shared by the invoice HTML and PDF renderers (and the page layout).
import { formatDate, formatDoctor, fullName, type LabProfile } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { amountInWords, computeInvoice, CURRENCY, money, type ComputedLine, type InvoiceTotals } from "./calc";
import { INV_BODY, INV_COLORS, INV_ROWS as R, INV_TOTALS, INV_W } from "./layout";
import type { Invoice, ItemCategory, PaymentStatus } from "./types";

export const CATEGORY_LABEL: Record<ItemCategory, string> = {
  test: "Laboratory Tests",
  profile: "Health Packages / Profiles",
  service: "Services",
  consumable: "Consumables",
  medicine: "Medicines",
  other: "Other Charges",
};
const ORDER: ItemCategory[] = ["test", "profile", "service", "consumable", "medicine", "other"];

export type InvRow = { kind: "group"; label: string } | { kind: "item"; line: ComputedLine; no: number };

/** Items grouped by category (tests first), numbered in printed order. */
export function invoiceRows(t: InvoiceTotals): InvRow[] {
  const rows: InvRow[] = [];
  let no = 0;
  const groups = ORDER.map((c) => t.lines.filter((l) => l.item.category === c)).filter((g) => g.length);
  for (const g of groups) {
    if (groups.length > 1) rows.push({ kind: "group", label: CATEGORY_LABEL[g[0].item.category] });
    for (const line of g) rows.push({ kind: "item", line, no: ++no });
  }
  return rows;
}

export const subLine = (l: ComputedLine) =>
  [l.item.hsn && `HSN ${l.item.hsn}`, l.item.note].filter(Boolean).join("  •  ");

export function rowHeight(r: InvRow): number {
  if (r.kind === "group") return R.group;
  return R.item + (subLine(r.line) ? R.itemSub : 0);
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------ columns */
export interface InvColumn {
  key: "no" | "desc" | "qty" | "rate" | "disc" | "tax" | "amount";
  header: string;
  w: number;
  align: "left" | "center" | "right";
}

export function invoiceColumns(t: InvoiceTotals): InvColumn[] {
  const showDisc = t.lines.some((l) => l.lineDiscount > 0);
  const cols: InvColumn[] = [
    { key: "no", header: "#", w: 0.35, align: "center" },
    { key: "desc", header: "Description", w: 0, align: "left" },
    { key: "qty", header: "Qty", w: 0.45, align: "center" },
    { key: "rate", header: `Rate (${CURRENCY})`, w: 0.95, align: "right" },
  ];
  if (showDisc) cols.push({ key: "disc", header: "Discount", w: 0.8, align: "right" });
  if (t.hasTax) cols.push({ key: "tax", header: "GST", w: 0.55, align: "center" });
  cols.push({ key: "amount", header: `Amount (${CURRENCY})`, w: 1.15, align: "right" });
  cols[1].w = INV_W - cols.reduce((a, c) => a + c.w, 0);
  return cols;
}

export function cellText(c: InvColumn, r: Extract<InvRow, { kind: "item" }>): string {
  const l = r.line;
  switch (c.key) {
    case "no":
      return String(r.no);
    case "desc":
      return l.item.name;
    case "qty":
      return String(l.qty);
    case "rate":
      return money(l.item.rate);
    case "disc":
      return l.lineDiscount ? `- ${money(l.lineDiscount)}` : "";
    case "tax":
      return l.item.taxPercent ? `${l.item.taxPercent}%` : "-";
    case "amount":
      // qty × rate − line discount; bill discount and GST are shown in the totals
      return money(l.gross - l.lineDiscount);
  }
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- totals */
export interface TotalLine {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  kind?: "grand" | "due" | "paid" | "muted";
}

export function totalLines(inv: Invoice, t: InvoiceTotals): TotalLine[] {
  const out: TotalLine[] = [{ label: "Subtotal", value: money(t.subtotal) }];
  if (t.lineDiscount) out.push({ label: "Item discounts", value: `- ${money(t.lineDiscount)}`, kind: "muted" });
  if (t.billDiscount) {
    const pct = inv.discount?.percent != null ? ` (${inv.discount.percent}%)` : "";
    out.push({ label: `Discount${pct}${inv.discount?.reason ? ` – ${inv.discount.reason}` : ""}`, value: `- ${money(t.billDiscount)}`, kind: "muted" });
  }
  if (t.hasTax) {
    out.push({ label: "Taxable value", value: money(t.taxable) });
    for (const g of t.taxByRate) out.push({ label: `GST @ ${g.rate}%`, value: money(g.tax), kind: "muted" });
  }
  if (t.roundOff) out.push({ label: "Round off", value: `${t.roundOff > 0 ? "+" : "-"} ${money(Math.abs(t.roundOff))}`, kind: "muted" });
  out.push({ label: "Grand Total", value: `${CURRENCY} ${money(t.total)}`, kind: "grand" });
  out.push({ label: "Amount Paid", value: money(t.paid), kind: "paid" });
  if (t.excess) out.push({ label: "Excess paid (refund)", value: money(t.excess), kind: "due" });
  else out.push({ label: "Balance Due", value: money(t.due), kind: "due" });
  return out;
}

export const STATUS_COLOR: Record<PaymentStatus, string> = {
  PAID: INV_COLORS.paid,
  "PARTIALLY PAID": INV_COLORS.partial,
  DUE: INV_COLORS.due,
};

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- cards */
export interface CardField {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  strong?: boolean;
}

export function patientCard(inv: Invoice): CardField[] {
  const p = inv.patient;
  return [
    { label: "Patient", value: fullName(p), strong: true },
    { label: "Age / Sex", value: `${p.age} ${p.ageUnit ?? "Year(s)"} / ${p.sex}` },
    { label: "Patient ID", value: p.patientId ?? "-" },
    { label: "Phone", value: p.phone ?? "-" },
    { label: "Ref. Doctor", value: formatDoctor(p.refDoctor) },
  ];
}

export function invoiceCard(inv: Invoice, t: InvoiceTotals): CardField[] {
  const modes = [...new Set((inv.payments ?? []).map((p) => p.mode))].join(", ");
  return [
    { label: "Invoice No", value: inv.invoiceNo, strong: true },
    { label: "Date", value: formatDate(inv.date) },
    { label: "Sample ID", value: inv.patient.sampleId ?? "-" },
    { label: "Payment", value: modes || "-" },
    { label: "Status", value: t.status },
  ];
}

/** UPI "scan to pay" when the lab has a UPI ID and money is due, otherwise a verification summary. */
export function invoiceQr(inv: Invoice, t: InvoiceTotals, lab: LabProfile): { value: string; label: string } {
  if (lab.upiId && t.due > 0) {
    const q = new URLSearchParams({ pa: lab.upiId, pn: lab.name, am: t.due.toFixed(2), cu: "INR", tn: `Invoice ${inv.invoiceNo}` });
    return { value: `upi://pay?${q.toString()}`, label: `Scan to pay ${CURRENCY} ${money(t.due)}` };
  }
  return {
    value: [
      lab.name,
      `Invoice: ${inv.invoiceNo}`,
      `Date: ${formatDate(inv.date)}`,
      `Patient: ${fullName(inv.patient)}${inv.patient.patientId ? ` (${inv.patient.patientId})` : ""}`,
      `Total: ${CURRENCY} ${money(t.total)}`,
      `Paid: ${CURRENCY} ${money(t.paid)}`,
      `Due: ${CURRENCY} ${money(t.due)}`,
    ].join("\n"),
    label: "Scan to verify",
  };
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------- notes block */
export function noteLines(inv: Invoice, lab: LabProfile): string[] {
  return [...(inv.notes ?? []), ...(lab.invoiceTerms ?? [])];
}

export const wordsOf = (t: InvoiceTotals) => amountInWords(t.total);

/** Height of the totals block (pt): the taller of the right panel and the left panel. */
export function totalsHeight(inv: Invoice, t: InvoiceTotals, lab: LabProfile): number {
  const right = totalLines(inv, t).reduce((a, l) => a + (l.kind === "grand" ? R.grand : R.totalsRow), 0);
  const pays = Math.max(1, inv.payments?.length ?? 0);
  const notes = noteLines(inv, lab);
  const left = R.wordsBox + R.blockGap + R.payHeader + pays * R.payRow + (notes.length ? R.blockGap + R.noteTitle + notes.length * R.noteLine : 0);
  return R.totalsGap + Math.max(right, left);
}

export const TOTALS_LEFT_W = INV_W - INV_TOTALS.rightW - INV_TOTALS.gap;

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------- pages */
export interface InvPage {
  rows: InvRow[];
  /** totals block printed on this page */
  totals: boolean;
  continued: boolean;
}

export const INV_CAPACITY = (INV_BODY.bottom - INV_BODY.top) * 72;

/** Splits items over A4 pages; the totals block always sits on the last page, whole. */
export function invoicePages(inv: Invoice, lab: LabProfile): { pages: InvPage[]; totals: InvoiceTotals } {
  const t = computeInvoice(inv);
  const rows = invoiceRows(t);
  const totalsH = totalsHeight(inv, t, lab);
  const pages: InvPage[] = [];
  let cur: InvRow[] = [];
  let used = R.tableHeader;
  const flush = (totals: boolean) => {
    pages.push({ rows: cur, totals, continued: pages.length > 0 });
    cur = [];
    used = R.tableHeader;
  };
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const h = rowHeight(r);
    // keep a group heading with its first item
    const need = r.kind === "group" && rows[i + 1] ? h + rowHeight(rows[i + 1]) : h;
    if (cur.length && used + need > INV_CAPACITY) flush(false);
    cur.push(r);
    used += h;
  });
  if (used + totalsH > INV_CAPACITY && cur.length) {
    flush(false);
  }
  pages.push({ rows: cur, totals: true, continued: pages.length > 0 });
  return { pages, totals: t };
}
```

## File: src/pdf.ts

```ts
// Node.js PDF export for invoices — no browser involved. Import only on the server.
import { renderToBuffer } from "@react-pdf/renderer";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { barcodeSvg, defaultLab, qrSvg, type LabProfile, type ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { assetsDir, loadImage, registerFonts, svgToPng } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { computeInvoice } from "./calc";
import { InvoicePdf } from "./InvoicePdf";
import { invoiceQr } from "./model";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

export { InvoicePdf } from "./InvoicePdf";

export interface RenderInvoicePdfOptions {
  invoice: Invoice;
  variant: ReportVariant;
  lab?: LabProfile;
  /** Folder that "/report-assets/…" paths resolve against. Default: report-kit's bundled assets */
  publicDir?: string;
}

/** Renders an invoice to an A4 PDF (Buffer). */
export async function renderInvoicePdf(opts: RenderInvoicePdfOptions): Promise<Buffer> {
  const lab = opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  const publicDir = opts.publicDir ?? assetsDir();
  registerFonts(join(publicDir, "report-fonts"));
  const header = opts.variant === "header";
  const [logo, email, phone, signature] = await Promise.all([
    loadImage(lab.logoSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.emailSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(lab.icons.phoneSrc, publicDir),
    loadImage(header ? lab.signatory.signatureHeaderSrc : lab.signatory.signatureNonHeaderSrc, publicDir),
  ]);
  const bar = barcodeSvg(opts.invoice.invoiceNo, "code128");
  const qr = invoiceQr(opts.invoice, computeInvoice(opts.invoice), lab);
  const images = { logo, email, phone, signature, barcode: bar ? svgToPng(bar) : undefined, qr: svgToPng(qrSvg(qr.value), 800) };
  const doc = createElement(InvoicePdf, { invoice: opts.invoice, variant: opts.variant, lab, images });
  return renderToBuffer(doc as Parameters<typeof renderToBuffer>[0]);
}
```

import { PROFILES, TEMPLATES, type TemplateId } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import type { ItemCategory } from "./types";

export interface PriceEntry {
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  /** rupees */
  rate: number;
  taxPercent?: number;
  hsn?: string;
}

/*
 * ⚠ SAMPLE PRICES — placeholders for the demo. Replace every rate (and any GST / HSN) with the
 * lab's real price list before billing patients.
 *
 * Test codes are the report-template ids, so a report's tests can be billed directly
 * (see itemsForTests). Pathology tests are generally GST-exempt; consumables/medicines may not be.
 */
const TEST_RATES: Record<TemplateId, number> = {
  cbc: 300, hb: 80, esr: 80, "blood-group": 100, mp: 150, "bt-ct": 100, "pt-inr": 350,
  "blood-sugar": 60, hba1c: 450, lft: 600, rft: 450, kft: 700, electrolytes: 400, lipid: 550,
  "iron-profile": 900, biochemistry: 150,
  thyroid: 500, "vitamin-d": 1200, "vitamin-b12": 900, psa: 700,
  dengue: 900, "hiv-hbsag-vdrl": 450, widal: 150, typhidot: 400, "malaria-antigen": 300, "crp-aso": 500, "ra-factor": 300,
  urine: 100, upt: 100, stool: 150, semen: 300,
};

const PROFILE_RATES: Record<keyof typeof PROFILES, number> = {
  "fever-profile": 1500,
  "diabetes-profile": 1800,
  "liver-kidney-profile": 1100,
  "anemia-profile": 1800,
  "antenatal-profile": 1600,
  "pre-operative-profile": 1700,
  "full-body-checkup": 3500,
};

export const PRICE_LIST: Record<string, PriceEntry> = {
  ...Object.fromEntries(
    (Object.keys(TEST_RATES) as TemplateId[]).map((id) => [id, { name: TEMPLATES[id].name, category: "test" as const, rate: TEST_RATES[id] }]),
  ),
  ...Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(PROFILE_RATES).map(([id, rate]) => [id, { name: PROFILES[id].name, category: "profile" as const, rate }]),

  // Services

  "report-copy": { name: "Duplicate Report Copy", category: "service", rate: 50 },
  // Consumables (sample GST / HSN — verify before use)
  "syringe-5ml": { name: "Disposable Syringe 5 ml", category: "consumable", rate: 10, taxPercent: 12, hsn: "9018" },

## File: src/server.ts

```ts
// Server-side helper: an invoice as a complete HTML document string. With `inline: true` (default)
// fonts and images are embedded, so the file works anywhere (email, archive, backend).
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { join } from "node:path";
import { createElement } from "react";
import { defaultLab, type LabProfile, type ReportVariant } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { assetsDir, inlineLab } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";
import { InvoiceDocument } from "./InvoiceDocument";
import type { Invoice } from "./types";

const FONT_BASE = "__MGPL_FONTS__";

export async function renderInvoiceHtml(opts: { invoice: Invoice; variant: ReportVariant; lab?: LabProfile; inline?: boolean; fontBase?: string }): Promise<string> {
  const { renderToStaticMarkup } = await import("react-dom/server");
  const inline = opts.inline !== false;
  const lab = inline ? inlineLab(opts.lab ?? defaultLab()) : opts.lab ?? defaultLab();
  let body = renderToStaticMarkup(createElement(InvoiceDocument, { invoice: opts.invoice, variant: opts.variant, lab, fontBase: inline ? FONT_BASE : opts.fontBase }));
  if (inline)
    body = body.replace(new RegExp(`${FONT_BASE}/([\w.-]+\.woff)`, "g"), (_, f: string) =>
      `data:font/woff;base64,${readFileSync(join(assetsDir(), "report-fonts", f)).toString("base64")}`,
    );
  return `<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"><title>Invoice ${opts.invoice.invoiceNo}</title><style>html,body{margin:0;background:#e8eaee}body{padding:24px 0}@media print{body{padding:0;background:#fff}}</style></head><body>${body}</body></html>`;
}
```

## File: src/types.ts

```ts
import type { Patient } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

export type ItemCategory = "test" | "profile" | "medicine" | "consumable" | "service" | "other";

/** One billed line. Money is in rupees (decimals allowed); maths is done in paise. */
export interface InvoiceItem {
  /** Price-list code, e.g. "cbc", "home-collection" */
  code?: string;
  name: string;
  category: ItemCategory;
  /** Default 1 */
  qty?: number;
  /** Unit price, rupees */
  rate: number;
  /** Line discount as a percentage of qty × rate … */
  discountPercent?: number;
  /** … or as a flat amount (rupees). Percent wins if both are set. */
  discountAmount?: number;
  /** GST %, e.g. 12 for consumables. Lab tests are usually exempt (0). */
  taxPercent?: number;
  /** HSN / SAC code, printed under the item */
  hsn?: string;
  /** Small note under the item, e.g. batch / expiry for medicines */
  note?: string;
}

export interface Payment {
  /** "Cash" | "UPI" | "Card" | "Online" | "Cheque" | … */
  mode: string;
  amount: number;
  date?: Date | string;
  /** Transaction / UTR / cheque number */
  reference?: string;
}

export interface Invoice {
  invoiceNo: string;
  /** Defaults to today */
  date?: Date | string;
  patient: Patient;
  items: InvoiceItem[];
  /** Bill-level discount, applied before tax and shared across the lines in proportion */
  discount?: { percent?: number; amount?: number; reason?: string };
  payments?: Payment[];
  /** Printed under the payment details */
  notes?: string[];
  /** Round the grand total to the nearest rupee (default true) */
  roundOff?: boolean;
  /** Heading, default "INVOICE" */
  title?: string;
}

export type PaymentStatus = "PAID" | "PARTIALLY PAID" | "DUE";
```
